newsitem.title: USA: MovieFone creates on-line product division.
newsitem.headline: MovieFone creates on-line product division.

text.p: MovieFone Inc said on Tuesday it is creating a new division for on-line products, which will include MovieLink, the company's movie information and ticketing site on the Internet.

Matt Blumberg, MovieLink's product manager, will head the new division, the company said. The division is working on a product that will send advanced notification of movies and other information to MovieLink users, Blumberg said, adding he expected the product to come out this summer.
